title: Speaking Practice 7 - Weather and Seasons
description: IELTS Speaking Part 1: Questions about weather and seasons.

stimuli.title: Part 1: Weather and Seasons
stimuli.content: Answer questions about weather preferences and seasonal activities.

questionGroups.instruction: Answer the following questions about weather.

questions.content: What is the weather like in your country?

explanation.sampleAnswer: Vietnam has a tropical climate, so it's generally hot and humid. We have two main seasons: the dry season and the rainy season.

questions.content: Which season do you like best?

explanation.sampleAnswer: I prefer autumn because the temperature is cooler and the scenery is beautiful with changing leaves.

questions.content: Does the weather affect your mood?

explanation.sampleAnswer: Yes, definitely. I feel more energetic on sunny days, while rainy days make me want to stay in bed.

questions.content: What do you usually do on rainy days?

explanation.sampleAnswer: I usually stay indoors, read books, or binge-watch TV series. Sometimes I enjoy listening to the rain while having a cup of coffee.

questions.content: Has the climate in your area changed recently?

explanation.sampleAnswer: I think so. Summers seem to be getting hotter each year, and the rainy season has become more unpredictable.
